title: German Apple Pudding
description: A classic German dessert, this apple pudding is a warm and comforting treat. Made with tender love, it's perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Peel, core, and chop the apples into small pieces.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and softened butter until a crumbly mixture forms.
Add the milk, vanilla extract, and egg yolks to the bowl and mix until smooth.
Stir in the chopped apples and Canadian tart cherries.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the pudding is set and the top is golden brown.
Serve warm, topped with whipped cream or a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired.
